mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluations (id, course_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, content, rating, create_time, update_time, delete_flag) VALUES (#{id}, #{courseId}, #{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{content}, #{rating}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM evaluations WHERE id = #{id} AND delete_flag = 0

SELECT c.id as course_id, c.start_time, CASE WHEN c.student_id = #{userId} THEN c.coach_id ELSE c.student_id END as opponent_id, CASE WHEN c.student_id = #{userId} THEN coach.name ELSE student.name END as opponent_name, CASE WHEN c.student_id = #{userId} THEN 'coach' ELSE 'student' END as opponent_role, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, c.start_time, c.end_time) as duration, c.table_number FROM courses c LEFT JOIN user student ON c.student_id = student.id LEFT JOIN user coach ON c.coach_id = coach.id WHERE (c.student_id = #{userId} OR c.coach_id = #{userId}) AND c.status = 'completed' AND c.delete_flag = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluations e WHERE e.course_id = c.id AND e.from_user_id = #{userId} AND e.delete_flag = 0 ) AND c.end_time <= NOW() ORDER BY c.start_time DESC

SELECT e.id, e.course_id, e.from_user_id, from_user.name as from_user_name, from_user.role as from_user_role, e.to_user_id, to_user.name as to_user_name, to_user.role as to_user_role, e.rating, e.content, e.create_time, c.start_time as course_start_time, c.end_time as course_end_time, c.table_number as course_table_number, c.status as course_status FROM evaluations e LEFT JOIN user from_user ON e.from_user_id = from_user.id LEFT JOIN user to_user ON e.to_user_id = to_user.id LEFT JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.id WHERE e.from_user_id = #{userId} AND e.delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY e.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM evaluations e WHERE e.from_user_id = #{userId} AND e.delete_flag = 0

SELECT e.id, e.course_id, e.from_user_id, from_user.name as from_user_name, from_user.role as from_user_role, e.to_user_id, to_user.name as to_user_name, to_user.role as to_user_role, e.rating, e.content, e.create_time, c.start_time as course_start_time, c.end_time as course_end_time, c.table_number as course_table_number, c.status as course_status FROM evaluations e LEFT JOIN user from_user ON e.from_user_id = from_user.id LEFT JOIN user to_user ON e.to_user_id = to_user.id LEFT JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.id WHERE e.course_id = #{courseId} AND e.delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY e.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) as total_received, AVG(rating) as average_rating, MAX(create_time) as last_evaluation_time FROM evaluations WHERE to_user_id = #{userId} AND delete_flag = 0
SELECT * FROM evaluations WHERE to_user_id = #{toUserId} AND delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
